name: vuelix
description: Animated, copy-paste components for Vue 3 & Nuxt, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and motion-v.

items.name: CTA Button
items.description: Call-to-action buttons with a shimmer sweep, spinning gradient border, magnetic pull or sliding arrow.

items.name: Expanding Button
items.description: A compact button that springs open into an inline panel of actions or a small form, then folds back.

items.name: Icon Swap
items.description: Button that morphs between icon states — copy to check, play to pause — with an optional particle burst.

items.name: Spring Button
items.description: A button with springy hover/press physics and a morphing loading state.

items.name: Theme Toggle
items.description: A sun/moon toggle with a rotating swap animation.

items.name: Color Picker
items.description: HSV color picker with springy thumbs, hex/RGB/HSL fields, eyedropper, recents and a popover variant.

items.name: Color Swatches
items.description: Color picker where a springy ring hops between swatches, with an optional custom color.

items.name: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select whose options glide in and out as you type, with the matched text highlighted.

items.name: Date Range Picker
items.description: A calendar popover with presets, a range band that stretches between dates and sliding months.

items.name: Dial Picker
items.description: A circular dial: drag the knob around a ticked arc, it snaps to steps while the readout rolls.

items.name: Floating Input
items.description: Text field whose label springs up on focus, with an animated focus ring, clear button and sliding error.

items.name: Motion Select
items.description: Single-select dropdown that scales out of its trigger, with a gliding highlight and drawn-in check.

items.name: Multi Select
items.description: Pick many options: choices pop into the field as chips and reflow with layout animation.

items.name: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code input with popping digits, a blinking caret and an error shake.

items.name: Radio Cards
items.description: Radio group where the selection ring and dot spring between options, as cards or a compact list.

items.name: Range Slider
items.description: Single or dual-thumb slider with growing thumbs, a value bubble that follows, and an animated fill.

items.name: Spring Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox that squishes on press and draws its check mark in, with an indeterminate state.

items.name: Spring Switch
items.description: A toggle whose thumb springs across and stretches while pressed.

items.name: Wheel Picker
items.description: An iOS-style 3D scroll wheel with flick momentum that snaps to items; combine wheels for time pickers.

items.name: Animated Tooltip
items.description: A lightweight tooltip that springs out from any side with a blur-in.

items.name: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile-style sheet with snap points, velocity-aware dragging and a background that scales back.

items.name: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click / long-press menu with a gliding highlight, shortcuts and a submenu that slides out.

items.name: Expanding Modal
items.description: A modal that grows out of the exact button that opened it and collapses back into it.

items.name: Morphing Dialog
items.description: A card that morphs into a full dialog using a shared layout transition.

items.name: Spring Drawer
items.description: A side drawer that springs in from any edge, with a drag-to-dismiss handle and focus trap.

items.name: Spring Popover
items.description: A click-to-open popover that springs out of its trigger, with an arrow and smart flipping.

items.name: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a shared-layout indicator that glides between triggers.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb trail that staggers in, underlines the current page and springs open collapsed levels.

items.name: Dock
items.description: A magnifying dock where icons grow as the pointer approaches.

items.name: Pagination
items.description: Page buttons with a sliding active pill, smart ellipses and numbers that roll with the direction.

items.name: Spring Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar that springs between full width and an icon rail, with a gliding active indicator.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: Multi-step progress with spring-filled connectors, steps that morph into checks and a pulsing current step.

items.name: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A fluid box that holds a ratio and springs smoothly to a new shape when the ratio changes.

items.name: Aurora Background
items.description: A section backdrop of soft, slowly drifting gradient blobs with optional film grain; transform-only and light on CPU.

items.name: Bouncy Accordion
items.description: Accordion panels that open with a bouncy height spring and blur-in content.

items.name: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure whose content springs open to its natural height and blurs into focus.

items.name: Hover Highlight
items.description: List, nav or grid where one shared background glides to the hovered item and fades out on leave.

items.name: Orbit Carousel
items.description: Cards on a 3D ring: drag to spin with inertia that snaps to the nearest card, or let it orbit slowly.

items.name: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card lit by a soft spotlight and glowing rim that follow the pointer, with a gentle hover lift.

items.name: Tilt Card
items.description: A 3D card that tilts toward the pointer with a moving glare.

items.name: Marquee
items.description: Seamless infinite scroller in any direction that eases to a stop on hover, with faded edges.

items.name: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a value with spring physics when scrolled into view.

items.name: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Reveals children with staggered presets as they scroll into view, plus a springy reading progress bar.

items.name: Text Reveal
items.description: Staggered word or character reveal with blur and lift.

items.name: Alert
items.description: Inline alert whose icon pops and draws itself in, with a dismiss that smoothly collapses its height.

items.name: Loader
items.description: Five loaders — wave, orbit, bars, ring and a typing skeleton — that calm down for reduced motion.

items.name: Pull to Refresh
items.description: Pull a scroll area down with rubber-band resistance; a spinning indicator holds while your refresh runs.

items.name: Toast Stack
items.description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover, with a tiny imperative API.

items.name: Avatar Group
items.description: Overlapping avatars that spread apart on hover with springy name tags.

items.name: Data Table
items.description: A sortable, selectable table whose rows glide into their new order and whose selection bar slides up.

items.name: File Tree
items.description: A keyboard-navigable file tree whose folders spring open and whose selection glides between rows.

items.name: Filmstrip
items.description: A gallery preview with a draggable thumbnail rail; a frame glides to the active shot as images slide in.

items.name: Lightbox
items.description: An image grid whose thumbnails morph into a full-screen viewer you can swipe through or drag away.

items.name: Motion Badge
items.description: Badge with odometer-style rolling counts and an optional pulsing live dot.

items.name: Sortable List
items.description: A drag-to-reorder list where rows lift off the page and the rest glide aside; keyboard friendly.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: A vertical timeline whose line draws in as you scroll while each event pops and slides into place.

items.name: Action Bar
items.description: A floating bulk-action bar that springs in on selection, rolls its count and confirms in place.

items.name: Auth Form
items.description: Sign-in / sign-up card with a sliding mode switch, floating labels, a live strength meter and a morphing submit.

items.name: Availability Picker
items.description: Weekly scheduler with day switches, animated time ranges and a drag-to-paint week grid.

items.name: Card Fan
items.description: A hand of cards dealt from a deck into a springy fan; hover to lift, click to play, shuffle to re-deal.

items.name: Command Palette
items.description: A ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, a gliding selection, nested pages that slide in and shortcuts.

items.name: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that springs its width, height and radius between live states while the content cross-fades.

items.name: Expandable Tabs
items.description: An icon-only tab bar where the active tab springs open to reveal its label with a blur-in.

items.name: Feedback Widget
items.description: A floating Feedback pill that morphs into an emoji-rating form, then into a check, then back.

items.name: File Dropzone
items.description: Drag-and-drop uploads that swell on hover, with thumbnails, live progress bars, retry and remove.

items.name: Fluid Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose indicator stretches like liquid between triggers while panels slide and resize.

items.name: Folder Stack
items.description: A folder whose flap tips open as its cards fan out, plus a card pile that deals itself into a grid.

items.name: Masonry Grid
items.description: Shortest-column masonry that springs into place on resize, reveals items on scroll and loads more at the end.

items.name: Match Fixtures
items.description: A fixtures and results list with live minutes, rolling scores, goal flashes and an expandable events timeline.

items.name: Morphing Search
items.description: A search icon that springs open into a field, with recent searches and suggestions that stagger in.

items.name: Not Found
items.description: A 404 section whose giant digits float, dodge the pointer on springs and can be flung around, with search and links home.

items.name: Notification Center
items.description: A bell with a live badge and a panel of per-app stacks that fan open, swipe away and clear in a cascade.

items.name: Odds Card
items.description: A prediction-market card: rolling odds, a live sparkline and Yes/No buttons that morph into an order panel.

items.name: Overflow Toolbar
items.description: A toolbar that measures its width and springs the actions that don't fit into a “more” menu.

items.name: Radial Menu
items.description: A floating button that blooms into a ring of actions with staggered springs, hover labels and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: Swipe Actions
items.description: List rows that swipe to reveal actions, rubber-band, full-swipe to commit and collapse away.

items.name: Token Swap
items.description: Swap card whose rows trade places on a spinning button, with token search, slippage and a review morph.

items.name: Wallet Card
items.description: A stack of payment cards that springs a card to the front, flips it for details and rolls in its balance.

items.name: Agent Activity
items.description: Live feed of an agent's steps: new steps slide in, the current one shimmers, sub-steps fold away.

items.name: Approval Card
items.description: Asks the user to approve an agent action, then collapses into a compact resolved row with a stamp that slams in.

items.name: Chat App
items.description: A complete AI chat: header, welcome screen with suggestions, streaming messages and a prompt composer.

items.name: Chat Message
items.description: A chat message with avatar, streaming caret and copy, retry and feedback actions that fade in on hover.

items.name: Chat Scroller
items.description: A conversation viewport that sticks to the latest message, springs in a jump pill and keeps its place on prepend.

items.name: Citations
items.description: Numbered citation chips with hover cards, linked to a sources list that lights up the cited source.

items.name: Code Block
items.description: Code with a file header, line numbers, highlighted lines, a copy-to-check button and a springy collapse for long snippets.

items.name: Conversation Sidebar
items.description: Chat history grouped by date, with search, a gliding active marker, inline rename and an icon rail.

items.name: File Diff
items.description: A unified diff viewer with a change bar, folding unchanged lines and per-hunk accept or reject that springs shut.

items.name: Image Generation
items.description: Image placeholder where grainy colour fields sharpen behind a scan line, then the result fades in.

items.name: Model Picker
items.description: Compact AI model dropdown with capability badges, typeahead and a check mark that glides to your pick.

items.name: Prompt Input
items.description: An AI composer with an auto-growing textarea, pop-in attachment chips and a send button that morphs into stop.

items.name: Streaming Text
items.description: Streamed AI answers where each new chunk blurs in, with a blinking cursor and light Markdown.

items.name: Suggestion Chips
items.description: Prompt suggestions that stagger in, lift on hover, fly into your input on click and reshuffle.

items.name: Task List
items.description: An agent's plan with a live progress bar, spinning active step, drawn checkmarks and a strike that sweeps across.

items.name: Thinking Indicator
items.description: AI loading states: wave dots, shimmering text, a pulsing orb, a scan bar and a collapsible reasoning panel.

items.name: Tool Call
items.description: A collapsible card for a tool invocation with a live status indicator, timer and pretty-printed arguments and result.

items.name: Voice Orb
items.description: A living orb for voice assistants that deforms with the audio level as it listens, thinks and speaks.

items.name: Bar Chart
items.description: Grouped, stacked or horizontal bars that spring up in a stagger and glide between layouts.

items.name: Bump Chart
items.description: Rankings over time as curved lanes that draw in; hover one to bring it forward and dim the rest.

items.name: Candlestick Chart
items.description: Live OHLC candles with volume, a last-price tag and crosshair readout; new candles slide in.

items.name: Depth Heatmap
items.description: Price × time heatmap of resting liquidity with a price trace; new snapshots slide in live.

items.name: Donut Chart
items.description: Rounded ring segments that sweep in; hovering one swells it and counts its value up in the centre.

items.name: Forecast Fan
items.description: Price history that opens into a fan of low / median / high targets, with a scrubber that reads into the future.

items.name: Funnel Chart
items.description: Conversion funnel whose stages spring open in sequence, joined by curved hand-offs with drop-off rates.

items.name: Heat Calendar
items.description: A year of daily activity as a weeks × weekdays grid that ripples in; drag across days to select a range.

items.name: Line Chart
items.description: Multi-series line or area chart that draws in, morphs on new data and tracks a snapping crosshair.

items.name: Order Book
items.description: Live bid/ask ladder with springy depth bars, a spread row, size-change flashes and a buy/sell balance bar.

items.name: Returns Calendar
items.description: Years × months grid of returns tinted by sign and size, with compounded yearly totals; cells pop in diagonally.

items.name: Sankey Chart
items.description: Weighted flows between columns of nodes; ribbons draw in and hovering traces a node's whole path.

items.name: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny trend line that draws itself in, with a smooth monotone curve.

items.name: Stacked Area
items.description: Composition over time, stacked or 100%; bands morph between modes and an interactive legend isolates series.

items.name: Status History
items.description: Uptime bars per day that rise in a wave, coloured by status, with an overall uptime readout.

items.name: Treemap
items.description: Squarified treemap whose tiles glide to their new size and position whenever the data changes.

items.name: Volume Profile
items.description: Volume-by-price histogram with a highlighted point of control and value area; bars ripple out from the POC.

items.name: Chart Utils
items.description: Shared chart helpers: nice ticks, scales, monotone paths, tweened values and a clamped tooltip.
